items.excerpt: Albany firefighters responded to a blaze on Central Avenue on Tuesday morning. Crews closed the street while they worked the scene.
items.headline: Fire breaks out on Central Avenue in Albany, crews on scene

items.excerpt: Firefighters in Albany battled a Central Avenue blaze Tuesday. Officials closed part of Central Avenue to traffic during the response.
items.headline: Albany firefighters battle Central Avenue blaze, street closed

items.excerpt: A fire on Central Avenue in Albany prompted road closures Tuesday morning, officials said. No injuries were immediately reported.
items.headline: Central Avenue fire in Albany prompts closures, officials say
